tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' yang dag kun gyi gnad nas

bzung ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /bka' yang dag kun gyi gnad nas bzung ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang dpal yongs grub thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos dus thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/ don dam yin na rang stong yin mi srid/ /rang stong yin na don dam yin mi srid/ /chos dbyings yin na rang stong yin mi srid/ /rang stong yin na chos dbyings yin mi srid/ /chos nyid yin na rang stong yin mi srid/ / rang stong yin na chos nyid yin mi srid/ /chos sku yin na rang stong yin mi srid/ /rang stong yin na chos sku yin mi srid/ /yongs grub yin na rang stong yin mi srid/ /rang stong yin na yongs grub yin mi srid/ /de bzhin nyid ni rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na de bzhin nyid ma yin/ /yang dag mtha' ni rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na yang dag mtha' ma yin/ / chos kyi gnas ni rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na chos kyi gnas ma yin/ /chos skyon med na rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na chos skyon med par min/ /sher phyin zab mo rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na sher phyin zab mo min/ /dbu ma zab mo rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na dbu ma zab mo min/ /phyag rgya chen po rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na phyag rgya chen po min/ /rang byung ye shes rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na rang byung ye shes min/ /'gog bden zab mo rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na 'gog bden zab mo min/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na lhan cig skyes sbyor min/ /don dam tshad ma rang stong ma yin la/ / rang stong yin na don dam tshad ma min/ /don dam sangs rgyas rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sangs rgyas min/ /don dam dam chos rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dam chos min/

/don dam dge 'dun rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dge 'dun min/ /don dam dkon mchog rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dkon mchog min/ /don dam ye shes rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam ye shes min/ /don dam lha tshogs rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam lha tshogs min/ /don dam dkyil 'khor rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dkyil 'khor min/ /don dam gsang sngags rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam gsang sngags min/ /don dam rgyud sde rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam rgyud sde min/ /don dam phyag rgya rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam phyag rgya min/ /don dam dngos grub rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dngos grub min/ /don dam rdo rje rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam rdo rje min/ /don dam sems dpa' rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sems dpa' min/ /don dam pad ma rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam pad ma min/ /don dam bha ga rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam bha ga min/ /don dam khu rdul rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam khu rdul min/ /don dam zla nyi rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam zla nyi min/ /don dam sgra gcan rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sgra gcan min/ /don dam dus me rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dus me min/ /don dam srid gsum rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam srid gsum min/ /don dam khams gsum rang stong ma yin la/ / rang stong yin na don dam khams gsum min/ /don dam dus gsum rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dus gsum min/ /don dam sku gsum rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sku gsum min/

/don dam sku bzhi rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sku bzhi min/ /don dam sku lnga rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam sku lnga min/ /don dam rnam mkhyen rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam rnam mkhyen min// don dam 'dod chags rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam 'dod chags min/ /don dam zhe sdang rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam zhe sdang min/ /don dam gti mug rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam gti mug min/ /don dam nga rgyal rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam nga rgyal min/ /don dam phrag dog rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam phrag dog min/ /don dam ser sna rang stong ma yin la/ / rang stong yin na don dam ser sna min/ /don dam phung po rang stong ma yin la// rang stong yin na don dam phung po min/ /don dam khams rnams rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam khams rnams min/ /don dam skye mched rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam skye mched m-in/ /don dam rten 'brel rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam rten 'brel min// don dam phar phyin rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam phar phyin min/ /don dam stong nyid rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam stong nyid min/ /don dam dran pa rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dran pa min/ /don dam spong ba rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam spong ba min/ /don dam rdzu 'phrul rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam rdzu 'phrul min/ /don dam dbang po rang stong ma yin la/ /rang stong yin na don dam dbang po min/ /don dam stobs rnams rang stong ma yin la// rang stong yin na don dam stobs rnams min/ /byang chub yan lag rang stong ma yin te/ /'phags lam yan lag la yang de bzhin no/

/'phags pa'i bden pa bsam gtan tshad med sogs/ /don dam rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos kun yang*/ /rang stong ma yin yin na don dam gyi/ /chos rnams thams cad gtan nas ma yin no/ /de ltar rtogs nas rang stong gzhan stong gis/ /khyad par rtogs nas bstan pa gsal nus so/ /'di yang rdzogs ldan gyi lugs su bkod pa ste/ gsum ldan mar bcad kyi lugs las ches khyad du 'phags pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ bha wan+tu/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gsung*/bka' yang dag kun gyi gnad nas bzung ba/ - PAGE 164 -- PAGE 165 -- PAGE 162 -
